title: Cluster headache: an open evidence base
description:
A reproducible, machine-readable record of cluster headache research: every registered trial and its result, the eight GWAS risk loci and their tissue-level effects, mechanism and provocation findings, and the research and funding landscape — with the code that regenerates all of it from public sources.

Cluster headache affects roughly 1 in 1,000 people and has one NIH-funded research lab in the United States. The literature is scattered and no maintained synthesis exists; this is an attempt at one.

The evidence record and the hypotheses derived from it are kept in separate documents. The record is intended to be useful independently of the claims.

Includes eight computational analyses run against ClinicalTrials.gov, NIH RePORTER, GTEx, PubChem (IUPHAR/Guide to Pharmacology), Open Targets, PubMed and OpenAIRE.
